findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The coving tiles on the wall by the shelves holding the soda syrups was observed coming off the wall. The PIC was made aware. There PIC assured inspector that gap will be sealed. Ensure that the coving in the area mentioned is sealed providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.16(B) Wall and Ceiling Coverings and Coatings. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: The back exit door is observed with visible light present. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that they will put a ticket in to get the back exit door sealed properly. Ensure this door receives repairs that allow the door to seal completely with no visible light present in order to protect the facility from the entry of insects and rodents.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the accumulation of ice behind the fan unit in the walk-in freezer and around the door. The accumulated ice is causing the door to not fully seal allowing air in and out of the walk-in freezer. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that the relevant repairs will get done. Ensure that the accumulated ice is cleaned to allow the door to be fully sealed when closed including cleaning the accumulated ice in the walk-in freezer.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: The ice machine is observed with mold/build-up present on the ice machine baffle on the lower lip and on the top sealed portion inside the machine. Ensure these areas are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current build-up of debris and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. For the top portion of the ice machine, the existing caulking will need to be scrapped, the area cleaned and sanitized, and then a new seal placed. This was observed on the 4/25/2024 inspection report and an additional follow-up-sup is being scheduled for 5/16/2024. 
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: There was an employee observed to wash their hands and shut off the faucet without the use of a barrier. This behavior was corrected on site and the employee rewashed their hands and utilized a barrier to shut off the faucet. Ensure that employees are retrained on how to properly wash their hands.
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: There was an employee observed to use their phone and place on a beard net and then start to put on gloves. This behavior was corrected on site and the employee was instructed to wash their hands again after having contaminated them. Ensure employees are trained on when and how to properly wash their hands. 
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The ice scoop is observed with food debris on it and in the container the scoop is being stored in. This scoop and container were removed from service and placed into the wash, rinse, sanitize cycle. Ensure these items remain clean to sight and touch and are washed, rinsed, and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: The back exit door is observed with visible light present. Ensure this door receives repairs that allow the door to seal completely with no visible light present in order to protect the faciltiy form the entry of pests. 
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following locations are observed with an accumulation of food/soil debris:
-the surface of the hot holding door hinges next to the fryer.
-the signs and surface of the fryer hood.
-The wires hanging from the walk-in cooler fan.
-the inside of the fryer where the filter unit is located.
Ensure these areas are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current build-up of food debris/soils and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The front surface of the cold holding unit along the front line is observed with food spills present. This cooler was cleaned during the inspection with the santiizer rag. Ensure this surface is cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas are observed to have an accumulation of soils/debris:
-The air vents in the kitchen on the ceiling have dust accumulation.
-The floor under the bun toaster has food and grease accumulation.
Ensure these areas are cleaned to remove the current build-up of soil/debris and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.13: The floor coving near the walk-in cooler is observed in a state of disrepair. Ensure this coving is attached to the wall to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.
